# Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-347#start-follow-up-from-a-file-diff

## Verdict

**Caught.** Maintained proof exercised the out-of-range line path and failed when the line-side membership check was removed.

## Story and revision

- **Identity:** SEED-347#start-follow-up-from-a-file-diff
- **Story:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-347-follow-up-from-a-file-diff.md#start-follow-up-from-a-file-diff`
- **Plan:** `.planning/slice-plans/619-follow-up-from-a-file-diff/PLAN.md`
- **Revision probed:** `18795f28e801f28710533eeb253cce361f8b3bea` (closure tip including execution-complete)
- **Scratch checkout:** `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-347-follow-up-file-admission-scratch` (detached worktree; execution checkout left untouched)
- **Local gate:** `caffeinate -s -i`; machine on AC Power, battery charged (100%)

## Suggestion validation

Caller suggestion reused without consequential revision.

- **Promise (Required restriction):** the dashboard server checks that the file and line on that side belong to the Done story's comparison; it refuses anything that does not match, and nothing starts; page-supplied context text stays refused.
- **Plausible fault:** remove the out-of-range line membership check in `dashboard/server/followUpFileAdmission.ts` (`admitLineOnSide`).
- **Focused command:** backend file follow-up admission suite as suggested (both specs).

## Fault introduced

In scratch only, removed:

`if (file.line > textLines(side.text).length) throw lineMissing();`

from `admitLineOnSide`, leaving the non-text-side refusal intact. Fixtures and assertions unchanged.

## Maintained check examined

- Suite: `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-file-admission.spec.ts` and `agent-launch-follow-up-file.spec.ts`
- Catching case: `refuses a file follow-up naming a line outside the comparison before starting claude` (parameterized; `change: { line: 9_999, side: "new" }`)
- Catching assertion: `expect(response.status, response.body).toBe(refused.status)` at `agent-launch-follow-up-file-admission.spec.ts:150` (expected `409`)
- Bound claim: this path is the out-of-range **line** membership check on a published-completion file anchor; not a claim about file-outside-comparison, absent-side, or page context-text refusals (those stayed green under this fault).

## Reach and wrong-behavior observation

Faulted run independently showed the promised refusal failed on that path:

- Response status **200** instead of **409**
- Body `kind: "accepted"` with follow-up file `line: 9999`, `side: "new"`
- Composed context included `- Line: 9999` / `- Side: new` (agent would receive a location the comparison does not contain)
- Assertion failed: Expected `409`, Received `200`

So the maintained check both exercised the wrong path and caught it.

## Run observations

Command (all three phases):

```sh
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH
caffeinate -s -i -- env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES \
  npx playwright test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts \
  dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-file-admission.spec.ts \
  dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-file.spec.ts \
  --reporter=list
```

| Phase | Runner result | Runner runtime |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baseline (pre-fault) | 9 passed | 16.4 s |
| Faulted | 1 failed, 8 passed — catch on out-of-range line refusal | 11.1 s |
| Restored | 9 passed | 10.8 s |

## Restoration

- `git checkout -- dashboard/server/followUpFileAdmission.ts` restored the membership check (`file.line > textLines(side.text).length`).
- Scratch `git status --porcelain` matched pre-probe (`?? node_modules` only; setup symlink, not a product edit); `git diff` empty.
- Restored suite: 9 passed (10.8 s).
- Execution checkout `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/start-a-follow-up-session-from-a-file-diff` remained at `18795f28…` without this probe's edit.

## Next proof action

No new proof action required for this promise/path: the maintained out-of-range line refusal already catches the fault. Keep that assertion and journey; do not weaken `admitLineOnSide` line membership. Broader restriction facets (file outside comparison, absent side, page context text) were not the selected fault and already have sibling cases in the same admission suite.

No already-planned repair disposition matched; this probe does not create a repair decision.

- **Test runtime.** 38.3 s (measured), sum of Playwright reporter totals for baseline 16.4 s + faulted 11.1 s + restored 10.8 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately instrumented human time for this probe.
- **Agent effort.** Estimated ~80 s wall time for lookup, scratch setup, three focused runs, restore, and report prep (from invocation start through prepared body), not a separately billed agent metric.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 96321 ms (measured), from 1794637416765 to 1794637513086 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
